function.name: + (addition)
function.description: Adds two numbers.
function.semantics: Integer fields are Long, Number fields are Double. Check for null first, an operator unboxes the value.

function.name: - (subtraction)
function.description: Subtracts the second number from the first.

function.name: * (multiplication)
function.description: Multiplies two numbers.

function.name: / (division)
function.description: Divides the first number by the second.
function.semantics: Two Integer values divide as whole numbers: 5 / 2 is 2. Make one of them a Number to get 2.5.

function.name: % (remainder)
function.description: The remainder of a division.
function.semantics: Useful to split a stream, e.g. keep the even rows with number % 2 == 0.

function.name: + (text concatenation)
function.description: Glues values together into a String.
function.semantics: A null value becomes the text null, so check for null when that matters.

function.name: == (equal)
function.description: Compares two values.
function.semantics: For Strings, Dates and other objects use equals() instead: == compares references, not content.

function.name: != (not equal)
function.description: The opposite of ==.

function.name: > (greater than)
function.description: Compares two numbers or dates.
function.semantics: Comparing a null value throws a NullPointerException when it is unboxed, check for null first.

function.name: < (less than)
function.description: Compares two numbers or dates.

function.name: >= and <= (at least, at most)
function.description: Compares two numbers, including the value itself.

function.name: && (and)
function.description: True when both sides are true.
function.semantics: The right side is only evaluated when the left side is true, which is what makes a null check in front of a method call work.

function.name: || (or)
function.description: True when one of both sides is true.
function.semantics: The right side is only evaluated when the left side is false.

function.name: ! (not)
function.description: Turns true into false and false into true.

function.name: ? : (if else)
function.description: Picks one of two values, the if-else of an expression.
function.returns: the type of the two values
function.semantics: There is no if statement in an expression, this is how a choice is written.

function.name: length()
function.description: The number of characters of a String.

function.name: isEmpty()
function.description: Whether a String has no characters at all.
function.semantics: A field that is empty in the stream often arrives as null, so combine it with a null check.

function.name: trim()
function.description: The String without leading and trailing whitespace.

function.name: toUpperCase()
function.description: The String in upper case.

function.name: toLowerCase()
function.description: The String in lower case.

function.name: substring(from)
function.description: The part of a String from a position to the end.
function.semantics: Positions start at 0. A position past the end of the String throws.

function.name: substring(from, to)
function.description: The part of a String between two positions.
function.semantics: The first position is included, the second is not.

function.name: indexOf()
function.description: The position of a piece of text in a String.
function.semantics: Returns -1 when the text does not occur.

function.name: lastIndexOf()
function.description: The position of the last occurrence of a piece of text.

function.name: contains()
function.description: Whether a String contains a piece of text.

function.name: startsWith()
function.description: Whether a String starts with a piece of text.

function.name: endsWith()
function.description: Whether a String ends with a piece of text.

function.name: equals()
function.description: Whether two Strings have exactly the same content.
function.semantics: Write the constant first: it is null safe, field.equals("abc") throws when the field is null.

function.name: equalsIgnoreCase()
function.description: Whether two Strings are the same, ignoring case.

function.name: compareTo()
function.description: Compares two Strings alphabetically.
function.semantics: Negative when the first is smaller, 0 when they are equal, positive when it is larger.

function.name: replace()
function.description: Replaces every occurrence of a piece of text.

function.name: replaceAll()
function.description: Replaces everything that matches a regular expression.

function.name: matches()
function.description: Whether a String matches a regular expression.
function.semantics: The pattern has to match the whole value, surround it with .* to match a part of it.

function.name: split()
function.description: Cuts a String into pieces.
function.semantics: The result is an array, [0] is the first piece.

function.name: String.valueOf()
function.description: Turns any value into a String.

function.name: Math.abs()
function.description: The value without its sign.

function.name: Math.round()
function.description: The nearest whole number.

function.name: Math.floor()
function.description: Rounds down to a whole number.

function.name: Math.ceil()
function.description: Rounds up to a whole number.

function.name: Math.max()
function.description: The largest of two numbers.

function.name: Math.min()
function.description: The smallest of two numbers.

function.name: Math.pow()
function.description: The first number to the power of the second.

function.name: Math.sqrt()
function.description: The square root of a number.

function.name: Math.random()
function.description: A random number between 0 and 1.
function.semantics: Evaluated again for every row, e.g. to take a sample of a stream with Math.random() < 0.1

function.name: longValue()
function.description: The Integer field as a plain number, to compare it.
function.semantics: An Integer field is a java.lang.Long, this is how it is compared without surprises.

function.name: doubleValue()
function.description: The Number field as a plain number, to compare it.

function.name: Long.parseLong()
function.description: Reads a whole number out of a String.
function.semantics: Throws when the text is not a number, the row then ends up in the error handling of the transform.

function.name: Double.parseDouble()
function.description: Reads a decimal number out of a String.

function.name: BigDecimal compareTo()
function.description: Compares two BigNumber values.
function.semantics: BigNumber values are compared with compareTo(), not with > or <.

function.name: BigDecimal add()
function.description: Adds to a BigNumber value.

function.name: BigDecimal setScale()
function.description: Rounds a BigNumber to a number of decimals.

function.name: new Date()
function.description: The moment the row is evaluated.
function.semantics: The expression has no imports, so classes are used with their full name.

function.name: before()
function.description: Whether a date lies before another one.

function.name: after()
function.description: Whether a date lies after another one.
function.semantics: Months start at 0 in GregorianCalendar: 0 is January.

function.name: getTime()
function.description: The date as a number of milliseconds since 1970.
function.semantics: Subtract two of them to get the time between two dates.

function.name: days between two dates
function.description: The number of whole days between two dates.

function.name: format a date
function.description: Turns a date into text.

function.name: parse a date
function.description: Reads a date out of text.
function.semantics: Throws when the text does not match the pattern.

function.name: == null
function.description: Whether a field has no value.
function.semantics: Fields arrive as objects, a field without a value is null.

function.name: != null
function.description: Whether a field has a value.

function.name: Boolean.TRUE.equals()
function.description: Whether a Boolean field is true, also when it is null.
function.semantics: Null safe: flag == Boolean.TRUE compares references and unboxing a null value throws.

function.name: Objects.equals()
function.description: Whether two values are equal, null included.
function.semantics: Returns true when both are null, and never throws.

function.name: toString()
function.description: Any value as text.
function.semantics: Throws when the field is null, String.valueOf() does not.

function.name: Long.valueOf()
function.description: Text as an Integer value.

function.name: Double.valueOf()
function.description: Text as a Number value.

function.name: new String(binary)
function.description: A Binary field as text.
function.semantics: A Binary field arrives as a byte[].

function.name: a Timestamp field
function.description: Compares a Timestamp field with a moment in time.
function.semantics: A Timestamp field is a java.sql.Timestamp, which is a java.util.Date as well, so before(), after() and getTime() all work on it.

function.name: the nanoseconds of a Timestamp
function.description: The sub-second part of a Timestamp field.
function.semantics: This is what a Timestamp adds to a Date, a Date only goes down to milliseconds.

function.name: read a member of a JSON field
function.description: Reads a value out of a JSON field.
function.semantics: A JSON field is a Jackson JsonNode. get() returns null when the member is not there, so check with has() first when it is optional. asInt(), asLong(), asDouble() and asBoolean() read the other types.

example.comment: Filters on a number inside the document.

function.name: a JSON field has a member
function.description: Whether a JSON field contains a member with this name.
function.semantics: The JSON equivalent of row.exists(): the document of one row can hold members another one does not have.

function.name: walk into a JSON field
function.description: Reads a value deeper in a JSON field.
function.semantics: path() never returns null, it gives back a missing node, so a chain of them is safe on documents that do not have the whole structure.

function.name: an Internet Address field
function.description: The address of an Internet Address field as text.
function.semantics: An Internet Address field is a java.net.InetAddress, so isLoopbackAddress(), isSiteLocalAddress() and the other methods of that class are available as well.

example.comment: Filters on the network an address belongs to.

function.name: a Binary field as text
function.description: Reads a Binary field as text.
function.semantics: A Binary field arrives as a byte[]. binary.length is its size in bytes.
